data: In fiscal 2024 (the year ended December 31, 2024), Tesla reported total revenues of about $97.69 billion, roughly 1% higher than the $96.77 billion it reported in fiscal 2023. Gross profit was approximately $17.45 billion, which gives a gross margin of about 17.9%, down from roughly 18.2% in fiscal 2023. Operating income was about $7.08 billion, for an operating margin of roughly 7.2%, compared with about $8.89 billion and 9.2% in fiscal 2023. The lower operating margin mainly reflects lower average vehicle selling prices and higher operating expenses, especially research and development spending on AI and autonomy projects, partly offset by growth in the energy storage business.
